description.value: A small-batch specialty coffee roastery with an on-site cafe nestled in the heart of Esquimalt on Vancouver Island. Coffee is roasted locally with a focus on single-origin and blended beans sourced from Rwanda, Guatemala, Colombia, and Ethiopia. They recently opened a second location called ERC Gateway on Esquimalt Road.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 9m; rack (1 space) at 15m; rack (1 space) at 35m; rack (3 spaces) at 36m; rack (3 spaces) at 79m; rack (3 spaces) at 83m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active specialty coffee roastery and cafe at 505 Park Place in Esquimalt, with phone 250-590-3775 matching the OSM record. OSM has outdoor_seating=yes but the website does not explicitly mention outdoor seating, bike parking, or any cycling-specific amenities. The website is primarily an e-commerce Shopify site for selling roasted coffee beans, with limited detail about the physical cafe experience. No evidence found for water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other amenities on the website.

enrichment_extras.notes: Business also operates a second location at 854 Esquimalt Rd #101 (ERC Gateway), phone 236-896-0575. The OSM record corresponds to the original Town Square cafe location.
